figurative_meaning_en: various kinds or all sorts of things
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনে কত কি দেখেছি, কিন্তু এমনটা কখনো হয়নি।
এই শহরে কত কি আছে দেখার।
example_sentences_in_english: I've seen all sorts of things in life, but nothing like this.
There's so much to see in this city, all sorts of things.
history: References Rabindranath Tagore's poem line: 'একলা বসে বাদলশেষে শুনি কত কি', evoking a sense of introspection and the vastness of experiences in nature.
note: Often used to express the multiplicity of experiences or observations in a reflective context.
